Clicking the blank part of a file row in the end-of-turn "Edited N files" card no longer jumps the side pane to Changes.

- The whole row of a file in that card was one button, including the blank space that lines the `+N −N` chips up on the right. A click meant for the conversation (to select text, or to bring the window forward) could land there and switch the pane from the preview or whatever you were reading to Changes. Now only the file name and its `+N −N` chips open Changes; the space between them does nothing
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.80.3 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
